description: Target-only postconditions for the react-native-view-shot React Native 0.84.1 -> 0.85.0 upgrade. Every predicate is evaluated with the SAME side-agnostic semantic check on both the source and the target worktree; the source worktree is expected to FAIL every predicate and the target worktree to PASS every predicate.

predicates.android_runtime_routing: Android RNViewShotModule selects the UI manager at runtime (instanceof FabricUIManager / UIManagerModule fallback) and no longer relies on the compile-time BuildConfig.IS_NEW_ARCHITECTURE_ENABLED gate.
predicates.android_release_confinement: Android releaseCapture() only deletes a direct child of the internal/external cache directory.
predicates.android_e_unable: Android capture failures reject with the E_UNABLE_TO_SNAPSHOT error code.
predicates.android_webm_alias: Android treats the webm extension as the WEBP format (deprecated alias).
predicates.ios_view_registry: iOS RNViewShot schedules through viewRegistry_DEPRECATED and resolves views with viewForReactTag: instead of self.bridge.uiManager addUIBlock: / viewRegistry[target].
predicates.ios_release_confinement: iOS releaseCapture() only unlinks a direct, non-escaping file name under the ReactNative temp directory.
predicates.ios_data_uri: iOS serializes data-uri results as data:image/<subtype>;base64,<base64> with jpg mapped to jpeg.
predicates.ios_base64: iOS supports the base64 result mode.
predicates.rndep_085: The root devDependency react-native resolves to 0.85.0 in package.json and package-lock.json while the peer range stays >=0.76.0.
predicates.public_capture_ref: The public surface still declares captureRef.
predicates.public_capture_screen: The public surface still declares captureScreen.
predicates.public_release_capture: The public surface still declares releaseCapture.
predicates.public_viewshot_component: The default export is still the ViewShot component with capture().
predicates.react_native_config: react-native.config.cjs is still present as a supporting build asset.
